items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I think that's one of the greatest works I've heard in American music.

ctx.x: Were you conscious of Gershwin's writing, particularly conscious of Gershwin's work in those years?

I understand that he is the Schillinger system. For Porgy and Bess I think he used that and I think that's one of the greatest works I've heard in American music. That opera-- is it considered an opera?
